name: Django Full-Stack Development

skills.name: HTML and CSS Foundations
skills.description: Create semantic documents and responsive, accessible presentation.

skills.name: JavaScript Foundations
skills.description: Use browser JavaScript, events, DOM APIs, and asynchronous requests safely.

skills.name: Django Projects and Apps
skills.description: Organize settings, apps, URL configuration, and environment-specific runtime concerns.

skills.name: Django Routing and Views
skills.description: Map URLs to bounded request handlers and responses.

skills.name: Django Templates

skills.name: Forms and Validation
skills.description: Validate and normalize browser input with clear errors.

skills.name: Django ORM and Modeling

skills.name: Django Migrations

skills.name: Authentication

skills.name: Authorization and Ownership

skills.name: CSRF, Sessions, and Cookies
skills.description: Protect state changes and configure browser session boundaries.

skills.name: Secure File Uploads

skills.name: Django JSON APIs
skills.description: Build authenticated, validated, bounded JSON endpoints and safe errors.

skills.name: Query Optimization

skills.name: Django Testing
skills.description: Test models, services, permissions, endpoints, migrations, and failure paths.

skills.name: Django Web Security

skills.name: Deployment Concepts
